tweetText: Visa has integrated its payment system with ChatGPT, allowing AI agents to recommend products and complete transactions without human help. This innovation streamlines shopping and enhances efficiency in retail purchasing. via AI News
Xebia's CTO emphasizes that AI agents won't succeed without a strong data foundation. Proper data access is crucial for leveraging AI effectively and enhancing organizational processes. via AI News

Avataar AI has launched a cost-effective video AI model for India, priced at just $0.005 per second. This innovation could enhance video creation at scale, making it accessible for more creators and businesses. via TechCrunch AI

Jeff Bezos's startup Prometheus has raised $12B to develop an 'artificial general engineer' for physical tasks, now valued at $41B. This could revolutionize industries like engineering and pharmaceuticals. via TechCrunch AI

Deezer launched a tool that scans playlists on Spotify, Apple Music, and more to identify AI-generated music. This innovation helps users distinguish between human-made and AI music, enhancing their listening experience. via TechCrunch AI

DoorDash launched a new AI chatbot, Ask DoorDash, enabling users to order by typing prompts or uploading photos. This makes ordering food easier and more intuitive, enhancing the user experience. via TechCrunch AI

Apple’s Camera Chief believes AI can enhance photography by adding fake pixels in iOS 27's Photos app. This innovation aims to improve user experience without relying on AI just for hype. via WIRED AI
SpaceX is gearing up for an IPO, and you might already own shares without knowing it. This could change how everyday investors engage with groundbreaking tech companies. via WIRED AI

OpenAI engineer Thibault Sottiaux is leading a major transformation of ChatGPT, building on its success in AI coding. This overhaul could enhance user experience and expand its impact in the AI space. via WIRED AI.

Apple's new Siri is designed to avoid being overly engaging or demanding personal info, unlike other chatbots. This approach emphasizes user privacy and control, setting Apple apart in the AI conversation. via The Verge AI.
